# Doctrines

Doctrines offer specialized passives, attribute increases, and unique rule-breaking mechanics
to customize and empower your adventurers. Each doctrine contains 7 ability nodes
upgraded using doctrine points.

## Doctrine of Affliction

<img :src="$withBase('/images/doctrine_of_affliction.png')" class="sprite" alt="doctrine_of_affliction" width="48" height="48">

Followers of this doctrine believe that suffering is synonymous with strength. They willingly inject themselves with an unknown pathogen that brings unrelenting agony and an insatiable thirst for blood. Over time, they have adapted to endure—and even revel in—the torment of their decaying flesh.

## Doctrine of Control

<img :src="$withBase('/images/doctrine_of_control.png')" class="sprite" alt="doctrine_of_control" width="48" height="48">

Adherents of the Doctrine of Control seek absolute dominance over themselves and others. They refine techniques to manipulate their enemies by commanding the elements and wield powerful abilities that grant them access to even the most guarded minds.

## Doctrine of Fortitude

<img :src="$withBase('/images/doctrine_of_fortitude.png')" class="sprite" alt="doctrine_of_fortitude" width="48" height="48">

Adherents of the Doctrine of Fortitude regard resilience as the ultimate virtue. They subject their bodies to relentless physical trials, pushing themselves to the brink of destruction and beyond. Through sheer determination and unyielding discipline, they transform pain and exhaustion into unshakable strength, forging a will as unbreakable as steel.

## Doctrine of Grace

<img :src="$withBase('/images/doctrine_of_grace.png')" class="sprite" alt="doctrine_of_grace" width="48" height="48">

Followers of the Doctrine of Grace are devoted to aiding the injured and the afflicted. They reject violence as a path to power, dedicating themselves instead to alleviating pain and suffering and bringing comfort to those around them.

## Doctrine of Knowledge

<img :src="$withBase('/images/doctrine_of_knowlegde.png')" class="sprite" alt="doctrine_of_knowlegde" width="48" height="48">

Followers of this doctrine are jack-of-all-trades, seeking to gain expertise in as many fields as possible. They believe that true power lies in the pursuit of pure knowledge, with its practical application being a secondary—though undeniably valuable—tool.

## Doctrine of Ruin

<img :src="$withBase('/images/doctrine_of_ruin.png')" class="sprite" alt="doctrine_of_ruin" width="48" height="48">

"Attack is the best defense" is the creed of those who follow the Doctrine of Ruin. They swiftly unleash the full potential of their destructive power, paying little to no regards to their own safety.
